description: Disconnect this OAuth connection by revoking the access+refresh chain that issued the token making this call. Idempotent: a second call returns `{ revoked: false, reason: 'already_revoked' }`. Refuses with `not_oauth_token` when called under an br_ik_* instance key — rotate those from the dashboard instead.
name: auth_revoke_self
title: Auth revoke self
